cards.text: The prophet Amos is bringing the LORD's word to the house of Israel, a people who trample the poor (Amos 5:11). Some of them are longing for the Day of the LORD, counting down to it like it's PAYDAY. And Amos says, "Woe to you who long for the Day of the LORD!"

cards.question: Amos asks what the Day of the LORD will be for the people longing for it. What's his answer?

cards.text: Then Amos paints a picture. A man is running for his life from a lion.

cards.question: In Amos's picture, the man who gets away from the lion is safe from then on.

cards.text: He gets away from the lion, only to encounter a bear. That's like sneaking out of a meeting to dodge your boss and running STRAIGHT into your boss's boss.

cards.question: Amos gives another picture: a man enters his house and rests his hand against the wall. What happens to him?

answers.text: He is bitten by a snake

cards.text: Then Amos asks: won't the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light, gloom with no brightness in it? Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, and trust me, nobody counts down the days to that.

cards.question: Now the LORD Himself speaks about Israel's feasts and solemn assemblies. What does He say about them?

cards.text: The LORD says He will not accept their burnt offerings and grain offerings, and He'll have no regard for their peace offerings of fattened cattle. Then He says, "Take away from Me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps."

cards.question: After turning down their feasts, offerings and songs, the LORD says what He wants instead: let ___ roll on like a river.

cards.text: Then the LORD asks, "Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?"
Then He names what they've taken along with them: Sakkuth their king and Kaiwan their star god.

cards.question: The LORD calls Sakkuth and Kaiwan the ___ they made for themselves.
Then comes the word "Therefore." The LORD, whose name is the God of Hosts, says what He will do to the house of Israel. What is it?

answers.text: Send them into exile beyond Damascus
Give them peace in their own land
Raise up a new king to lead them
